title: Program ani Source Code mhunnlear kitem?
learningObjectives: Program-acho orth aplea utramnim sangunk ani to computer chalu korunk shaktolea suchonanchem vyavasthit ghotton asa mhunn spost korunk ietolo.
Source Code-achi vyakhya diunk ani to manxam vachunk zata tya Programming Language-ant borovta mhunn vollkhunk ietolem.
Program ani Source Code hancher aslolem sombond spost korunk ani donui utram ekach orthant vaporpachi chuk tallunk ietoli.
Disa-disachem ek kam lhan, spost ani kraman borovillea suchonamnim vibhagunk ietolem.
Soppea udahronnant Input, Processing ani Output hanchi bhumika spost korunk ietoli.
Sadharon bhasent borovillea suchona ani Programming Language-chea nemam pramonn borovillea Source Code hancher farikpon sangunk ietolem.
Bhashe pramonn Compiler, Interpreter vo Runtime Source Code chalu korunk koshi modot kortat tem spost korunk ietolem.
Lhan Code udahronnant suchonacho kram vollkhun dar ek suchon kitem korta tem sangunk ietolem.
Syntax ani spostponnachem mahatv somjun aspasht suchonamni chukicho porinam kiteak mellta tem sangunk ietolem.
Samasye khatir gorjechea suchona nivdun apekshit porinam sangunk ietolem.
Program lhan pavlamnim spost korop, tapasop ani sudarop hache fayde vollkhunk ietolim.
Variables, Conditions, Loops ani Functions shikovpak gorjechi mool somaj vaddovunk ietoli.

understand.concept: Program mhunnlear ek kam purnn korunk computer chalu korunk shokta aslea suchonanchem ek vyavasthit ghotton. Source Code mhunnlear Programming Language-che nem vaprun programmer borovta ani manxam vachunk zata tem suchonanchem likhit rup. Program rochonk Source Code vaportat. Punn Source Code, chalu aslo Program, to korta ti kamam ani tache porinnam ekuch gost nhoi.
understand.whyItMatters: Programming suru zata tedna ek somasya computer spost ani borem ritin follow korunk zata aslea suchonamnim bodlunk zai. Somasya, upayachi yojon, Source Code ani chalu aslo Program hancher farikponn somzle zalear Code borovta tedna amkam khorem kitem rochchem asa tem kallta. Puddar Data, Decisions ani Repetition sarkhe vishoi shikpak ho payo zata.
understand.history: Computer ani Programming Languages vaddot gele tashi Program borovpachi rit bodloli. Survate hardware lagim aslelya suchona vaportale. Magir lokank aple vichar chodd vachunk sopya rupant borovpak zata ashi Languages vikasit zali. Aiz anek Languages ani Tools aslearui mool vichar toch asa: computer system process korunk zata aslea nemke suchonamnim upay mandop. Pratek Language-cho vistariit itihas tachea module-ant shikoytalet.
understand.analogy: Ek randpachi Recipe somzun gheiat. Tiat lagpi samugri ani korunk zai te pavol borovle astat. Tya pavolam paltat zalear Program chalu korp sarkem. Boriloli Recipe Source Code sarkhi asa, karonn donui kitem korunk zai tem sangtat.
understand.analogyLimit: Hi tulona purnn ritin sarki nhoi. Manis aplea onubhovan adhuri Recipe somzun gheun suttlele pavol andaz korun bharunk shokta. Computer Programming Language-che nem ani Program-ant dilelya suchona follow korta; sadharon buddhi vaprun ghallele suchona surakshit ritin puray korina.

explain.narrative:
Program koso rochta ani koso kam korta tem somzunk char vichar vegle dovor: somasya, upayachi yojon, Source Code ani chalu aslo Program.

Adim somasya olkho. Udahoronak, “don ankachi berij kaddop” hem ek kam asa, Code nhoi. Mag yojon kor: poilo ank ghe, dusro ank ghe, donui ek kora ani ekun dakhoi. Hi yojon konnachei ek Programming Language-acher adharit nhoi. Hanga Input mhunnlear don ank, Processing mhunnlear tanchi berij ani Output mhunnlear mellpi ekun.

Sadharon bhasent boriloli yojon manxank upyogi asa, punn ti apunnuch Source Code zata na. Source Code korunk Programming Language-che sobd, chinhn ani Syntax-che nem vaprun suchona borovchi podtat. Udahoronak JavaScript-ant Variables, + Operator ani console.log() vaprun hi yojon borovnk zata. Konnche sobd ani chinhn vaporp hem nivdlelya Language-acher adharit asa.

Program chalu zaupache adim vo chalu asotana computer system Source Code process korta. Hi rit Language ani tachea Implementation-acher adharit asa. Compiler Code dusrea rupant bodolunk shokta; Interpreter suchona chalu korunk shokta; Runtime Program chalu asotana gorjechea seva diunk shokta. Kitem Languages ani Tools he rit ekttaim vaportat. Mhunn pratek Program sodanch fakt Compiler vo fakt Interpreter vaporta mhunn sangop barobar nhoi.

Program chalu asotana tacheo suchona Data-acher kam kortat. Mellpi porinnam Output mhunntat. Output sodanch screen-acher dista to sandesh asop gorjechem nhoi. To Text, File, samballun dovorlo bodol, ganitacho porinnam vo dusrea System-k pathoili mahiti asu yeta. Program chalu naslearui Source Code ek File mhunn asu yeta. Chalu aslo Program mhunnlear suchona amalant haddpachi process; Source Code File-antlo text mat nhoi.

Ek bori savoy mhunnlear lhan Program chalu korche adim to kitem kortolo tem andaz kor ani magir khoro porinnam tulna kor. Farikponn aslear suchona, tanchi kram, Input molam ani Language Syntax tapasun po. Hya ritin vichar bharoshecho upay zata.

examples.explanation: Number keleli pavolam konnachei khas Programming Language vin upayachi yojon sangtat. JavaScript Statements tich yojon JavaScript Syntax-ant mandtat. const Statements don molank nanv ditat; + Operator tanka ekott korta; console.log() porinnam Console-k pathaita. Suchona chalu kel'yar Output 13 mellta. Source Code mhunnlear boril'lio suchona; 13 mhunnlear tanka chalu kel'yar mellpi porinnam.

practise.guidedTask: Don bostunchi ekun kimmat kaddpi ek lhan Program somzun ghe. Sadharon bhasent char pavolanchi yojon boroi. Gorjechi molam Input, ekott korpachi kriya Processing ani kaddloli ekun kimmat Output mhunn olkhoi. Hi yojon Source Code korunk konchem bhag Programming Language-ant porot borovp zai tem sang.
practise.independentTask: Minute second-ant bodlop vo don bostunchi ekun kimmat kaddop sarkem ek sopyem kam nivod. Language-independent yojon boroi ani Input, Processing ani Output olkhoi. Magir hi yojon Source Code mhunn kashi borovchi tem sang. Yojon, Source Code ani Program chalu zalyar mellpi porinnam hancher farikponn spost kor.
hints: Suchona borovche adim somasya spost kor.
Input mhunnlear gorjechem Data; Processing mhunnlear tya Data-acher korpi kam; Output mhunnlear mellpi porinnam.
Sadharon bhasent boriloli yojon apunnuch Source Code nhoi.
Source Code borovtana nivdlelya Programming Language-cho Syntax follow kor.
Suchona chalu zalyar Output mellta; Output apunn Source Code nhoi.
